# RizeUp Global

> Study-abroad consultancy for Bangladeshi students, based in Chattogram with an office in Shah Alam, Malaysia. Guides on university applications, student visas, scholarships and funding, written by practising counsellors.

All guidance below is written for students applying from Bangladesh. Figures quoted in articles are taken from official government sources and dated in the text; they change, so treat the article date as the currency of the numbers.

## Guides

- [Your First 30 Days Abroad: What Nobody Prepares You For](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/first-30-days-studying-abroad): Getting the visa is the part everyone plans for. The month after you land is the part that decides whether the first year goes well.
- [After You Graduate: Post-Study Work and Residency Routes Compared](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/post-study-work-pr-pathways-compared): If your plan is to stay after graduating, that decision belongs at the start, not at the end. What each destination offers and where the route quietly closes.
- [Bringing Your Spouse or Children on a Student Visa](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/bringing-spouse-dependents-student-visa): Dependant rules have tightened sharply in several countries. Who can still bring family, what it costs to prove, and why this is now a course-choice decision.
- [Working While You Study: The Real Rules, Country by Country](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/part-time-work-rules-international-students): Part-time work helps with living costs and will not pay your tuition. The hour limits are legal conditions on your visa, and breaking them can end your studies.
- [Paying for It: Education Loans and Funding Options in Bangladesh](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/education-loan-bangladesh-study-abroad): Student loans work differently here than students expect, and a loan can complicate your visa application if it is not documented properly. What the real options are.
- [Diploma and Polytechnic Holders: Your Options Abroad](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/diploma-polytechnic-students-study-abroad): A polytechnic diploma is not a dead end. Some countries will give you credit for it and let you enter a bachelor's part-way through, which saves a year or two of fees.
- [Public or Private University Abroad: What the Fee Difference Buys](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/public-vs-private-university-abroad): Bangladeshi students carry assumptions from home into a decision where they do not apply. Public is not automatically better abroad, and private is not automatically a fallback.
- [Duolingo, IELTS or PTE: Which English Test Should You Actually Take](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/duolingo-vs-ielts-vs-pte-bangladesh): The cheapest test is not always the right one, because the university may accept it and the visa office may not. How to choose without wasting a fee.
- [Just Finished HSC? Here Is How to Pick a Country Honestly](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/after-hsc-which-country-to-study-abroad): Most students pick a country first and then try to make their grades and budget fit it. Do it the other way round and the shortlist gets much shorter and much more useful.
- [Study in Dubai and the UAE from Bangladesh: Branch Campuses Explained](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-dubai-uae-from-bangladesh): You can take a British or Australian degree in Dubai, three hours from home, without a Western visa. What that actually gets you, and what it does not.
- [Study in China from Bangladesh: CSC Scholarships and What to Watch For](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-china-from-bangladesh): China funds a large number of Bangladeshi students, particularly in medicine and engineering. The scholarships are real, and so are the pitfalls.
- [Study in South Korea from Bangladesh: GKS and Self-Funded Routes](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-south-korea-from-bangladesh): Korea's government scholarship is one of the best-funded options open to Bangladeshi students, and it is far less contested than a UK or US application.
- [Study in Japan from Bangladesh: MEXT and the Route Most Students Miss](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-japan-from-bangladesh): Japan funds a lot of Bangladeshi students through MEXT, and the Embassy in Dhaka runs its own recommendation route. How both work and which one fits you.
- [Study in Italy from Bangladesh: How DSU Regional Scholarships Work](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-italy-from-bangladesh): Italy has low public tuition and a regional aid system most Bangladeshi students have never heard of. DSU can cover fees, a stipend and meals, if you apply properly.
- [Study in Canada from Bangladesh: Permits, Proof of Funds and Working](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-canada-from-bangladesh): Canada asks for more money up front than most destinations and refuses a lot of Bangladeshi applications. What the study permit actually requires and who it suits.
- [Who Can Sponsor Your Studies, and How to Prove Where the Money Came From](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/who-can-sponsor-student-visa-bangladesh): Visa officers do not just count your money, they trace it. Who is allowed to sponsor you, and the source-of-funds evidence that decides most Bangladeshi applications.
- [The Student File Explained: How Bangladeshis Actually Send Tuition Abroad](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/student-file-bangladesh-banks-explained): You cannot just wire tuition abroad from Bangladesh. The student file is the mechanism that makes it legal, and most students only learn about it late.
- [Study Gap: Which Countries Accept It and How to Explain Yours](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-gap-accepted-countries-bangladesh): A gap after HSC or your bachelor's is not the dealbreaker most Bangladeshi students think it is. What matters is whether you can account for the years.
- [How to Tell a Real Study-Abroad Consultancy from a Scam](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/how-to-spot-fake-study-abroad-agency-bangladesh): Bangladeshi students have lost crores to fake consultancies. Here are the warning signs, the questions that expose them, and what a legitimate agency will never ask you to do.
- [Student Visa Refused? What Actually Went Wrong and What to Do Next](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/student-visa-refusal-from-bangladesh): Why student visas get refused for Bangladeshi applicants, what your refusal letter is really telling you, and how to decide between an appeal and a fresh application.
- [Cheapest Countries to Study Abroad from Bangladesh (& How to Study for Free)](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/cheapest-countries-to-study-abroad): The most affordable countries to study abroad for Bangladeshi students, where tuition is low or free, and how to bring your total cost right down.
- [How to Apply to Universities Abroad: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/how-to-apply-to-universities-abroad): A clear, step-by-step guide to applying to universities abroad from Bangladesh, shortlisting, documents, applications, offers and avoiding common mistakes.
- [How to Write a Winning SOP (Statement of Purpose) for Study Abroad](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/how-to-write-an-sop-statement-of-purpose): A practical guide to writing a Statement of Purpose that gets you admitted, structure, what to include, common mistakes, and tips for university and visa SOPs.
- [Scholarships for Bangladeshi Students to Study Abroad (2026)](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/scholarships-for-bangladeshi-students-abroad): A practical guide to scholarships for Bangladeshi students, types of funding, how to qualify, where to look, and how to apply for scholarships abroad.
- [Student Visa & Pre-Departure Guide for Studying Abroad](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/student-visa-and-pre-departure-guide): A practical guide to the student visa and getting ready to leave, documents, interview prep, a pre-departure checklist and what to pack.
- [Study Abroad from Bangladesh: The Complete 2026 Guide](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-abroad-from-bangladesh-guide): A step-by-step guide to studying abroad from Bangladesh, choosing a country, budgets, requirements, applications, scholarships and visas, in plain language.
- [Study Abroad Without IELTS: MOI-Accepted Universities Explained](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-abroad-without-ielts-moi-accepted): You may be able to study abroad without IELTS using an MOI letter. Here's how MOI-accepted universities work and where the option applies.
- [Study in Australia from Bangladesh: Universities, Costs & Scholarships](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-australia-from-bangladesh): How Bangladeshi students can study in Australia, top universities, tuition fees, admission requirements, scholarships and how to apply.
- [Study in Europe from Bangladesh: Italy, France & Low-Cost Options](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-europe-from-bangladesh): Europe offers low-cost, English-taught degrees across Italy, France, Germany and more. Here's how Bangladeshi students can study in Europe affordably.
- [Study in Germany from Bangladesh: Free & Low-Cost Universities](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-germany-from-bangladesh): Germany offers free or very low tuition at public universities. Here's how Bangladeshi students can study in Germany, costs, requirements and how to apply.
- [Study in Malaysia from Bangladesh: Affordable Universities & Costs](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-malaysia-from-bangladesh): Malaysia is the most affordable, closest study-abroad option for Bangladeshi students, top universities, costs, MOI admissions and scholarships explained.
- [Study in the UK from Bangladesh: Universities, Costs & Scholarships](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-uk-from-bangladesh): How Bangladeshi students can study in the UK, fast one-year master's degrees, universities, tuition costs, scholarships and the application process.
- [Study in the USA from Bangladesh: Universities, Scholarships & Applications](https://rizeupglobal.com/blog/study-in-usa-from-bangladesh): How to study in the USA from Bangladesh, the range of universities, scholarships, costs, MOI-accepted options and the application process, explained.
